notes.title: Now You Can Choose The Game Difficulty Level!
notes.content:
[h1]I am excited to introduce a new feature in the latest update: [b]Difficulty Levels![/b]
[/h1]
Now, you can select the difficulty of the game, in Singleplayer and Multiplayer.
Whether you're a pro looking for a challenge or a newcomer seeking a more clear adventure.

notes.title: Update Notes For Version 0.6
notes.content:
[h2]I care deeply about all your reviews and will do my best to address them and achieve your expectations.[/h2]
[b]Version 0.6[/b] is now available! Here's what's new in this update:

[olist]
[*] Tutorial Cards: Added a card tutorial system in the inventory, to enhance the discovery experience.
[*] Display Multiple Languages: Now, player and room banners support multiple languages.
[*] Player Running Mechanic: You can now run with a single click on the Run key.
[*] Rooms Player Numbers: Added room members count to rooms lobby cards..
[*] Tasks Display Bug: Fixed an issue causing some tasks in displaying wrong task progression.
[*] Player Jump Bug: Fixed player jump bug causing a small jump.
[*] Gas Tank Leaking Timer Bug: Fixed the bug with the gas tank leaking timer.
[*] Achievements Bug: Fixed some bugs that made some achievement unobtainable.
[*] Player Inventory: Enhanced player inventory experience.
[/olist]

[b]I hope you enjoy these improvements, and I'm happy to read all your reviews to improve the game.[/b]
Thank you for playing and for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Notes For Version 0.5

notes.title: Update Notes For Version 0.4
notes.content:
Version 0.4 is now available! Here's what's new in this update:

[olist]
[*] More Tutorials: Added more tutorials for Room Lamps and Task Sheets to help you master the game mechanics from the beginning.
[*] Stuck in Walls: Fixed the wall bug in some rooms to prevent any clipping issues.
[*] Task Sheets: Added numbers tracing for the task sheets, to display progress for every subtask, making it easier to keep track of your tasks.
[*] Flashlight Stabilization: Improved flashlight intensity stability. Now, it will maintain 90% intensity for most of the battery life, instead of dropping off after 30% of the battery life.
[*] Enemy Spawn Rate: Decreased the goat spawn rate to make the map discovery more easy for the players.
[*] Player Stamina: Increased player stamina, to make it easier for the players to run from the goat enemy.
[/olist]

I hope you enjoy these improvements, and I'm happy to read all your reviews to improve the game.
Thank you for playing and for your continued support!
